purpose: Unseeded. Three agents, three ordinary feature requests on one real application, each in its own container on its own branch with no channel. Nothing is planted; the only thing arranged is that the three tasks approach the same surfaces.
shared_surfaces: the tRPC router table in src/server/routers/
the prisma migration sequence in prisma/migrations/
product_outcome: the repository's own checks on the merged tree: tsc --noEmit and vitest run

episodes.title: three ways to let readers respond to a post

prediction.frozen: textual. All three lanes need a new router registered in src/server/routers/_app.ts, and that registration is a one-line addition at the same place in the same file, so git should refuse. Convention hits: 0 migration ordinals (prisma timestamps differ by construction), 0 route paths (the three briefs name different domains), at most 1 config key (two lanes may both reach for a generic page-size or enabled flag). Stealth false, because a conflicted merge never reaches a suite. What would surprise me: a clean merge, which would mean at least one lane declined to touch the router table.
